purpose: External visual references used alongside original imagegen concepts and user-approved 16x24 sprites.
policy: Linked references only. No external photographs or Qud sprites copied into Assets. Attribution and source license metadata are retained for future decisions.

references.title: Qud: open ground and readable clusters
references.credit: Freehold Games; Caves of Qud official developer post
references.rights: Reference only; no asset reuse license established.
references.observed: Sparse vegetation, separated building fragments, dark open ground and a few bright focal colors remain legible together.
references.adaptation: Keep the clearing floor quiet. Group workstations and beds around paths; reserve bright warm pixels for characters, useful objects and readable state changes. Translate visual hierarchy into original silhouettes.
references.use: Clearing composition; all future biome readability reviews
references.avoid: Copying Qud sprites, characters, named creatures, dialogue or the screenshot's ground noise.

references.title: Ornavik: sheltered earthen oven
references.credit: Ornavik historical park; individual photographer not identified on the source page
references.rights: Reference only; source site reserves rights.
references.observed: A clay dome has a deeply dark opening, sits above a woven base, and is protected by a pole-and-thatch structure.
references.adaptation: Retain a broad dome and unmistakable dark oven mouth. Place wood and ash on the working side, with a small shelter or windbreak only where it helps the composition. Use three or four large color masses.
references.use: Cook's workspace and practical settlement construction
references.avoid: Photographic surface cracks, elaborate thatch noise, and a wholesale medieval-village theme.

references.title: Seed Savers Exchange: stored seed batches
references.credit: Seed Savers Exchange; individual photographer not identified on the source page
references.rights: Reference only; no image reuse license established.
references.observed: Clear containers expose differently colored seed batches and different fill heights; lids provide a strong repeated top edge.
references.adaptation: Use a few seed vessels with distinct contents/fill silhouettes, and connect storage visually to the existing sorting table and drying rack. The accompanying guide supports a harvest–dry–separate–store workflow; it does not authorize inventing new gameplay states.
references.use: Seed keeper sorting/storage props and environmental explanation
references.avoid: Modern brand marks, tiny illegible labels, or making every stored jar look like the approved beetle jar.

references.title: Garden Organic: dry seedhead structure
references.credit: Garden Organic; article by Alice Whitehead; image photographer not identified
references.rights: Reference only; no image reuse license established.
references.observed: Dry seedheads curl inward on spoke-like stems, with small clustered terminals and substantial holes between branches.
references.adaptation: Make stored seed bundles recognizable with three terminal clusters and bent stems. For future original flora, distinguish upright shoots from bent dry stalks by silhouette; fit art to each actual owner's growth rules.
references.use: Drying rack bundles; crop-state concept studies
references.avoid: Drawing every fine branch, inventing an EmberwheatCrop ripe stage, or treating all crops as the same seedhead.

references.title: Sundew: biological strangeness
references.rights: Source offers CC BY-SA 3.0 among its licenses. Kept as a linked observational reference; no photograph is incorporated into game assets.
references.observed: An elongated green leaf has outward-pointing stalks with red tips and bright droplets.
references.adaptation: Try one olive paddle, alternating short teeth, and three restrained red/cream tips. This is a candidate silhouette for an existing adhesive or insect-trapping plant, after confirming its mechanics and biome.
references.use: Unsettling flora; meaningful biological hazard cues
references.avoid: Specular sparkles everywhere or implying a hazard on a harmless plant.

references.title: Salt crust: preservation made visible
references.credit: Petar Milošević, Dead Sea salt crystals, 2023
references.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 on source page. Kept as a linked observational reference; no photograph is incorporated into game assets.
references.observed: A thick white crust sits above charcoal rock, with an uneven pendant lower edge and some dark rock still exposed.
references.adaptation: Use a pale upper mass with irregular two-pixel lobes, a dark seam and exposed muted material beneath. Apply only to lore-appropriate salt deposits, Curation preservation objects or troughs.
references.avoid: Snow-like uniform caps, generic glitter, or adding salt to unrelated surfaces.

references.title: Mangrove roots: wetland rhythm
references.rights: Source offers CC BY-SA 3.0 and GFDL. Kept as a linked observational reference; no photograph is incorporated into game assets.
references.observed: Pale tapered root spikes interrupt dark water in sparse groups; spreading trunks bridge some groups while open water remains visible.
references.adaptation: Use three asymmetric spikes of different heights, muted teal bases and occasional bent roots. Place uneven bands around water edges with passage gaps consistent with collision and pathfinding.
references.use: Sodden banks, crossing edges and quiet wetlands
references.avoid: An even carpet of identical spikes, hidden blockers or borrowing a real plant name as unsupported game lore.

references.title: Reclaimed ironworks: old purpose beneath growth
references.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 on source page, with explicit derivative/AI attribution guidance. Kept as a linked observational reference; do not transform the photo into a distributable texture without addressing those terms.
references.observed: Rigid steel beams retain their mechanical structure while ivy accumulates around joints and hangs from ledges.
references.adaptation: Build a charcoal squared frame, one rust seam and olive growth concentrated at a joint. Preserve evidence of a machine's original function and an accessible service side.
references.use: Sodden works, irrigation equipment and repurposed settlement structures
references.avoid: Random rubble, vines covering every surface, or phototexturing original models with the reference.
